function.name: generate_image_tool
function.description: Generates an image based on the provided description and saves it with the specified file name. The image description should be detailed to ensure the resulting image matches the desired subject and surroundings; otherwise, these aspects will be chosen randomly. This function is not intended for generating images from textual data. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

desc.description: A single string that provides a detailed description of the desired image. For example, 'a sunset over the mountains with a lake in the foreground'.

file_name.description: The name of the file to which the generated image will be saved. It should include the file extension, such as 'image.png'.

function.name: tts_tool
function.description: Converts the provided text content to speech and saves the resulting audio to a file. This function is intended for voice narration and should be used accordingly. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

content.description: The text content that needs to be converted to speech.

speaker.description: The voice to be used for the text-to-speech conversion.

function.name: write_markdown_tool

Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

content.description: The Markdown formatted text content to be written to the file.

filename.description: The name of the file to which the Markdown content will be written. If not provided, a default filename will be used.

function.name: write_html_tool

content.description: The HTML content to be written to the file. Must contain valid HTML structure.

filename.description: The name of the file to which the HTML content will be written. If not provided, a default filename will be used.

function.name: search_web_tool
function.description: Executes a search query using the DuckDuckGo search engine and returns a specified number of search results from a given source. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

query.description: The search term or phrase to be queried.

num_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return. A positive integer.

source.description: The source from which the search results should be fetched.

function.name: get_url_content
function.description: Scrapes the specified URL for textual data and returns the content as a string. This function is useful for extracting information from web pages when a URL is provided. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The web address of the page to scrape. It should be a valid URL format, such as 'http://www.example.com'.

timeout.description: The maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, with a default value that allows for a reasonable amount of time for most web pages to load.

user_agent.description: The User-Agent string to be used for the HTTP request to simulate a particular browser, which is optional. Some websites may require this for access.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the main tools (websites, apps, and APIs) you’ll find handy when looking to book flights:

| Category | Tool / Service | What it does | Typical use‑case |
|----------|----------------|--------------|------------------|
| **Consumer‑facing travel sites** | **Google Flights** | Search & compare prices across many airlines, see price trends, explore alternate dates. | Quick price checks, exploring “best‑time‑to‑book” windows. |
| | **Kayak** | Aggregates fares from multiple sources, offers price alerts, flexible‑date searches. | Finding deals, comparing bundles (flight + hotel). |
| | **Skyscanner** | Global fare comparison, “cheapest month” view, multi‑city itineraries. | Long‑haul trips, multi‑stop planning. |
| | **Expedia / Hotels.com** | Bundles flights, hotels, car rentals; loyalty points. | All‑in‑one bookings, package discounts. |
| | **Priceline / Hotwire** | “Name Your Own Price”, opaque booking for last‑minute savings. | Budget travelers, last‑minute deals. |
| | **Momondo** | Similar to Skyscanner but often shows different carriers. | Cross‑checking results, seeing hidden carriers. |
| | **Travelocity / Orbitz** | Legacy brands now under Expedia Group; similar features. | Brand preference, loyalty programs. |
| | **Airbnb Experiences** | Not a flight site, but sometimes includes “fly + stay” packages. | Experiential travel, unique stays. |
| | **TripIt** | Organizes itineraries, sends reminders. | Post‑booking organization. |
| | **FlightAware / Flightradar24** | Real‑time flight tracking, delays. | Monitoring status, sharing ETA. |
| | **SITA Airport App** | Airport‑specific app for check‑in, boarding passes. | Airport navigation, gate info. |
| | **Airline mobile apps** (e.g., Delta, United, Lufthansa) | Direct booking, seat selection, real‑time updates. | Loyalty members, frequent flyers. |
| | **Booking.com** | Primarily hotels, but also offers flight options via partner integrations. | Hotel‑centric travelers. |
| | **Ctrip / Trip.com** | Chinese platform with global reach, often cheaper rates for Asia. | Travelers targeting Asian routes. |
| | **Agoda** | Mainly accommodation, but has flight search in some markets. | Southeast Asia focus. |
| | **Rome2rio** | Shows multimodal transport options (flights, trains, buses). | Planning complex itineraries. |
| | **Google Maps** | Provides flight times between airports, helps estimate layover durations. | Rough time calculations. |
| | **FlightStats** | Historical performance data, airline punctuality stats. | Choosing reliable carriers. |
| | **OpenSky Network** | Open‑data API for flight tracks (for developers). | Building custom flight trackers. |
| | **FlightRadar24 API** | Commercial API for live flight data. | Integrating real‑time flight info into apps. |
| | **FlightAware API** | Flight status, historical data, alerts. | Enterprise solutions, travel agencies. |
| | **Amadeus for Developers** | Comprehensive travel API (airfare, availability, pricing). | Building travel tech products. |
| | **Sabre API** | Global distribution system (GDS) integration. | Travel agencies, corporate booking engines. |
| | **Travelport API** | Another GDS offering, supports multi‑channel distribution. | Corporate travel portals. |
| | **Kiwi.com API** | Builds itineraries, dynamic packaging, “no‑frills” booking. | Innovative travel startups. |
| | **Skyscanner API** | Access to flight search, price alerts, place lookups. | Embedding flight search widgets. |
| | **Google Flights API** (unofficial) | No official public API, but scraping or unofficial wrappers exist. | Custom flight search widgets. |
| | **Cleartrip API** | Indian market focus, flight + hotel bundling. | India‑centric travel services. |
| | **CheapOair API** | Offers flight search, booking, and ancillary services. | Affiliate marketing, travel blogs. |
| | **Expedia Rapid API** | Booking engine, inventory management. | Travel agencies, OTA partners. |
| | **Travelpayouts API** | Affiliate network, flight search, commission tracking. | Bloggers, affiliate marketers. |
| | **Skiplagged API** | Hidden city ticketing data, price analytics. | Advanced fare hunting. |
| | **Google Cloud Travel APIs** | Includes Places, Directions, and other location services. | Enhancing travel apps with maps. |
| | **Microsoft Azure Cognitive Services – Language** | NLP for parsing user intent in chatbots. | Building conversational booking assistants. |
| | **Twilio Programmable SMS / WhatsApp** | Sending booking confirmations, push notifications. | Customer communication. |
| | **Stripe / PayPal SDKs** | Payment processing for booking platforms. | Handling payments securely. |
| | **Zendesk / Freshdesk** | Ticketing systems for customer support. | Managing post‑booking inquiries. |

### How to choose:
1. **For end‑users**: Start with Google Flights or Skyscanner for a broad overview, then drill down with airline apps for seat selection and loyalty perks.
2. **For developers / agencies**: Pick a GDS (Sabre, Amadeus) if you need deep inventory and enterprise features; otherwise, use a simpler API like Skyscanner or Kiwi for rapid prototyping.
3. **For affiliates / bloggers**: Use Travelpayouts or CheapOair to embed flight widgets and earn commissions.

Feel free to ask if you’d like deeper dives into any specific platform, how to integrate them, or best practices for building your own flight‑search widget!
